role: initial segment of a strictly well-ordered set below a member
notes: The set of predecessors of w under the given strict well-order, ordered by its restriction.
Ordinal instance of the inherited max of a finite list of cardinals (sec:set-prerequisites-06); defined by ordinal trichotomy.

role: canonical well-order on a square of ordinals
notes: Compares maximum, then first coordinate, then second coordinate.

role: lexicographic key of a pair of ordinals
notes: k(alpha,beta) is the triple (max(alpha,beta),alpha,beta); local name.

role: lexicographic order on triples of ordinals
notes: Decided at the first index where the triples differ.

role: ordinal order isomorphic to an initial segment
notes: Unique by item 1 of that lemma; local name.

role: least ordinal bijective with an ordinal
notes: Defined without Choice for ordinals; it is a cardinal. Under Choice it agrees with the inherited |beta| of cor:cardinal-assignment.

role: set of finite sequences from a set
notes: Inherited notation of cor:syntax-counting; equal to the string set A^* of sec:strings-01.

role: finitary grammar given by base strings and formation rules
notes: The inductive definition of sec:strings-02 with universe Gamma^*.
